request_payload.title: Lentiviral haematopoietic stem-cell gene therapy for early-onset metachromatic leukodystrophy: long-term results from a non-randomised, open-label, phase 1/2 trial and expanded access.

mentions.sentence: Lentiviral haematopoietic stem-cell gene therapy for early-onset metachromatic leukodystrophy: long-term results from a non-randomised, open-label, phase 1/2 trial and expanded access.

candidates.label: Atidarsagene autotemcel (stem-cell gene therapy for MLD)
candidates.summary: The child's own blood stem cells are given a working ARSA gene and returned; their descendants supply the enzyme in the nervous system. Approved for pre-symptom

candidates.label: Haematopoietic stem cell transplantation (early, for Krabbe disease)
candidates.summary: Donor blood stem cells that supply galactocerebrosidase. The only disease-modifying option for Krabbe disease, and only effective when done very early.

candidates.label: Intrathecal AAVrh8-HEXA/HEXB gene therapy (Tay-Sachs)
candidates.summary: AAV vectors carrying working HEXA and HEXB genes given into the spinal fluid; first tested in two children with infantile Tay-Sachs disease under expanded acces

candidates.label: ETX101 (AAV9-delivered gene therapy for SCN1A Dravet syndrome)
candidates.summary: An AAV9-delivered gene therapy in phase 1/2 for SCN1A-positive Dravet syndrome.

candidates.label: AAV STXBP1 gene supplementation
candidates.summary: A virus-delivered extra copy of STXBP1, aimed at raising Munc18-1 back toward normal levels. Preclinical work set a transduction threshold; the first human tria

candidates.label: scAAV9.P546.SLC6A1 intrathecal gene replacement
candidates.summary: A virus-delivered extra copy of SLC6A1, given into the spinal fluid, to restore GABA re-uptake. First-in-human trial is open by invitation.

candidates.label: Kv7 potassium channel openers (ezogabine / retigabine, XEN496)
candidates.summary: Drugs that open KCNQ2/KCNQ3 (Kv7) potassium channels, studied in KCNQ2 encephalopathy due to loss-of-function variants.

candidates.label: Eliglustat (substrate reduction)
candidates.summary: An oral drug that slows production of the lipid that builds up in Gaucher disease (substrate reduction).

candidates.label: Stiripentol
candidates.summary: An anti-seizure medicine with an FDA label for seizures associated with Dravet syndrome in patients taking clobazam.

candidates.label: Levacetylleucine (N-acetyl-L-leucine)
candidates.summary: An oral modified amino acid that improved ataxia scores versus placebo in a 12-week crossover trial in NPC; it is also being trialled in GM2 gangliosidoses.

candidates.label: ARSA-related disorders (metachromatic leukodystrophy)
candidates.summary: Deficiency of arylsulfatase A makes sulfatides build up and destroys myelin in the brain and nerves, causing loss of motor and cognitive skills.

candidates.label: GALC-related disorders (Krabbe disease)
candidates.summary: Deficiency of galactocerebrosidase leads to toxic psychosine build-up that kills myelin-forming cells; the infantile form is rapidly fatal.

candidates.label: CACNA1A-related disorders
candidates.summary: Gene-defined umbrella for conditions caused by variants in CACNA1A (8 curated clinical entities in OMIM/Orphanet).
